_description: LLM content-quality guidance for banker page authoring and review. These rules are not a Python gate; validate_artifact.py only checks mechanical structure.

qc_advisory_targets._note: Advisory diagnostics only. Python validators may warn when these are missed, but should not fail content artifacts solely because an advisory target is missed.

min_chars_by_field_type._note: These are advisory targets. Fields shorter than the minimum generate a density_warning, not an error.

contextual_caution_phrases: 控股权出售迎来有利窗口
接近某上市公司盈利水平
weak_source_markers: 行业媒体/数据平台综合

cross_slide_distinctness_rules.description: Slide 3 should explain current growth drivers; Slide 7 should explain future industry evolution and transaction read-through. Do not repeat the same driver cards as trends.
Slide 4 should cover value chain / profit pool; Slide 5 should cover entry barriers / winner capabilities. Do not repeat channel or brand wording as the main point on both slides.

Slide 1 should establish industry attractiveness; Slide 8 should synthesize transaction read-through, project relevance, and evidence boundaries. Do not reuse the same market-size thesis as the transaction conclusion.

2.description: Slide 2 covers market size AND segmentation. The segmentation angle must be one clear axis — not a grab-bag mixing channel, sub-category, and price band.
anti_patterns: headline mixes two unrelated axes (e.g., market growth + channel shift)
chart_data shows market size time-series but headline emphasizes channel structure
body_copy has both channel share and sub-category growth as co-equal stories

3.description: Slide 3 should explain industry growth drivers first. Pitch relevance should be clear, and target context should be selective and secondary — do not mechanically add 'benefits target' to every driver card.
forbidden_headline_patterns: 标的.{0,12}(驱动|引擎|利好|受益)
3.preferred_body_focus_message: Slide 3 body_copy should contain industry demand/driver language; each card should explain a driver mechanism, not just state benefit to target.
anti_patterns: each driver card mechanically ends with 利好标的 or similar target benefit
driver cards are target-centric rather than industry-structure-centric
headline or subtitle makes the target the primary subject of drivers

4.description: Slide 4 should focus on industry value chain and profit pool first; project relevance is secondary.
forbidden_headline_patterns: 标的.{0,12}(最优|核心|制高点|利润池)

5.description: Slide 5 is industry barriers / value drivers with selective target context where relevant, not a target-only moat page.
forbidden_headline_patterns: 标的.{0,8}(护城河|竞争壁垒|壁垒)
目标公司.{0,8}(护城河|竞争壁垒|壁垒)
forbidden_main_message_patterns: 标的.{0,15}(护城河|竞争壁垒|壁垒|三重)
5.preferred_body_focus_message: Slide 5 body_copy should contain industry-level barrier / value driver language; it reads as target-only if no industry focus terms appear in body_copy.
anti_patterns: target-only moat page (every bullet about target capabilities)
each bullet mechanically starts with 行业/标的 paired structure
target superiority claim without external benchmark
headline or subtitle makes target the primary subject of barriers

6.description: Slide 6 should explain competitive landscape / peer segmentation first; project relevance is secondary.
forbidden_headline_patterns: 标的.{0,12}(差异化|优势|生态位|定位|胜出)
目标公司.{0,12}(差异化|优势|生态位|定位|胜出)
forbidden_main_message_patterns: 标的.{0,20}(差异化|优势|独特生态位|占据|胜出)
目标公司.{0,20}(差异化|优势|独特生态位|占据|胜出)
6.preferred_body_focus_message: Slide 6 body_copy should contain competitive landscape / market structure language; it reads as target-only if no landscape focus terms appear in body_copy.
anti_patterns: bullet primarily titled 标的位置 or 标的定位
table designed mainly to prove target differentiation
headline frames target as the primary subject of competitive landscape
body_copy has a dedicated target-positioning bullet alongside the table

7.description: Slide 7 is industry trends / future evolution. Target implications should be selective, not every trend framed as target benefit.
forbidden_headline_patterns: 标的.{0,12}(利好|受益|机会|趋势)
7.preferred_body_focus_message: Slide 7 body_copy should contain industry trend / evolution language; it reads as target benefit page if no industry trend focus terms appear in body_copy.
anti_patterns: every trend card ends with 标的含义 or 标的受益
subtitle says 均利好标的 or similar blanket target benefit claim
trend slide reads like target opportunity page rather than industry evolution
uses 均利好 / 精准契合 / 有望受益 without evidence qualification
presents sale-timing conclusion as an established fact
treats industry consolidation as synonymous with imminent target sale

8.description: Slide 8 should include balanced transaction read-through, project relevance, and evidence boundaries, not only positive target advocacy.
8.required_body_message: Slide 8 should include at least one concise evidence-boundary, caveat, or risk note framed as professional judgment rather than an unresolved-task checklist.
